zones.name: Whispering Woods
zones.description: A peaceful forest filled with ancient trees and gentle spirits. Perfect for beginners.
stories: discovered a hidden grove
encountered a friendly forest spirit
found a clearing with glowing mushrooms
heard whispers from the ancient trees
helped a lost traveler find their way

zones.name: Jade Mountains
zones.description: Towering peaks shrouded in mist, home to rare minerals and mysterious monks.
stories: climbed to a breathtaking summit
discovered a hidden monastery
found veins of precious jade
meditated with ancient monks
witnessed a dragon soaring above the peaks

zones.name: Azure Coast
zones.description: Sparkling beaches and mysterious tide pools. The sea holds many secrets.
stories: dove into an underwater cave
befriended a sea turtle
discovered a sunken treasure
witnessed a whale migration
found a message in a bottle from ages past

zones.name: Crimson Desert
zones.description: Endless red sands and scorching heat. Only the strong survive here.
stories: uncovered ancient ruins buried in sand
survived a sandstorm by taking shelter in a cave
found an oasis in the endless dunes
encountered a nomadic caravan
discovered hieroglyphs telling of a lost civilization

zones.name: Shadow Realm
zones.description: A dark dimension where light struggles to exist. The most dangerous zone.
stories: battled a shadow wraith and emerged victorious
found a rift between dimensions
discovered an ancient seal containing great power
resisted the whispers of the void
lit a lantern that pushed back the eternal darkness
